resources.string: The agent can read, search and send messages; every send needs your approval in AgentOS.
One SMS permission is missing, so the matching tools return an error.
No SMS permission: the agent can only hand a draft to the system messaging screen, and you press send yourself.
Can\'t grant it? Allow restricted settings first
Since Android 15 the system restricts SMS permissions for apps that were not installed from an app store. That is a protection, not a bug. Do these three steps once.
Tap ⋮ at the top right and choose \"Allow restricted settings\" (you may need to confirm your screen lock)
Come back here and tap \"Grant SMS permissions\"
No such item in the App info menu? Then the system is not restricting this app — just grant the permissions.

Message text the agent reads becomes part of the chat history and is sent to the model endpoint you configured in AgentOS. Every send needs your approval, and verification codes are masked by default. This app does not use the network itself and is not your default messaging app.
List chats, read, search, send (high risk, approved every time), check send status, prepare a draft
Cannot: MMS, group messages, delete, mark as read, pick a SIM, answer incoming messages on its own

Grant \"Read messages\" to browse your conversations here (read-only).

Delivery reports can be late or never arrive; \"Sent\" is often the final state.
The agent asked to write these in the messaging screen. Android does not let background apps open screens on their own, so if nothing popped up, tap Open.
Let the agent read verification codes
Off: codes show as •••••• — to the agent and in this app\'s chat view.
On: codes go into the chat history and to the model endpoint as they are.
Refused by default (10086, 106…) to avoid premium-rate messages and subscriptions.
Choose Chinese or English in the system\'s app language settings
This app is not your default messaging app: it reads the system message store and sends through the system SMS service. No MMS, group messages, deleting or marking as read.
